slides.headline: Cards Never Expire. Starbucks Still Books Breakage.
slides.subheadline: No expiry sounds reassuring. It doesn't prevent revenue from expected nonredemptions.​
slides.svgBlueprint: 540×800 viewBox. Apply the supplied palette throughout all seven slides. Place masthead at y=40, red kicker capsule at y=88, and 64px headline across four deliberate lines between y=150–420. Underline 'Still Books Breakage' in red. Add one oversized, faint card-outline emblem behind the lower headline. Set subheadline at 22px below. Place two compact telemetry badges above the bottom issue strip. No diagram, arrows, or callout cards.

slides.headline: Convenience Makes Prepayment Feel Harmless
slides.subheadline: Easy payments and gifting encourage repeat visits; customers pay before purchasing.​

items.title: THE REASSURANCE
items.body: No activation, service, dormancy or inactivity fees. Neither cards nor monetary balances expire.

items.title: THE EXCHANGE
items.body: Starbucks receives prepayment. Customers receive spending value—not interest or FDIC insurance.

slides.svgBlueprint: 540×800 viewBox. Use a 42px headline and 22px subheadline. Stack exactly two offset Surface cards: reassurance at x=32,y=270,w=444,h=180; exchange at x=64,y=475,w=444,h=180. Use 48px numerical badges, 18px labels and 22px body text. First card gets a thin Ink outline; second gets a red left rule. A single curved payment stroke connects them without additional labels. Reserve the bottom strip for publication and citations.

slides.headline: Neither Liability Measures Unused Gift-Card Cash
slides.subheadline: Two substantial balances mix different obligations. Neither isolates unused gift-card dollars.

items.title: CURRENT LIABILITY
items.body: Stored-value liability plus current deferred revenue, including $177.0 million from Nestlé’s upfront payment.

items.title: CARDS PLUS LOYALTY
items.body: Includes card balances and unredeemed loyalty Stars across current and long-term obligations.

slides.svgBlueprint: 540×800 viewBox. Place headline above a two-column diptych beginning at y=285. Give each column 222px width with a 32px central gutter and red divider. Set monetary numerals at 36px, never above 48px; place 'million' separately at 20px. Wrap each body into short 21px lines. Use subtle ledger rules behind the columns. Show the shared as-of date once above both panels. No proportional bars: the figures are differently scoped obligations, not comparable cash piles.

slides.headline: Expiration Isn't The Accounting Trigger
slides.subheadline: Historical nonredemption estimates release revenue proportionately as customers redeem their cards.

telemetry.label: Most cards historically redeemed within this period

items.title: CASH ARRIVES
items.body: Loads initially become deferred revenue: Starbucks has cash before delivering purchases.

items.title: PURCHASES HAPPEN
items.body: Redemptions convert the corresponding prepaid obligation into purchase revenue.

items.title: BREAKAGE IS RECOGNIZED
items.body: Historical patterns estimate nonredemption; proportional recognition accounts for applicable unclaimed-property remittances.

slides.svgBlueprint: 540×800 viewBox. Place two small numerical telemetry badges beneath the subheadline. Draw one vertical red spine at x=58 from y=315 to y=690, with exactly three unnumbered nodes. Align three 22px body blocks at x=94, each within a 130px-high band. Use a filled node for incoming cash, outlined node for redemption, and half-filled node for estimated breakage. Connect only these three stages. No expiry-clock icon or visual implication that an individual balance disappears.

slides.headline: The Revenue Is Real. Profit Isn't Disclosed.
slides.subheadline: Two disclosed revenue categories establish breakage—not fresh cash or standalone net profit.

items.title: TOTAL BREAKAGE
items.body: Recognized revenue from previously collected value—not newly received cash or disclosed standalone net profit.

items.title: COMPANY-OPERATED STORES
items.body: The company-operated component of the fiscal 2025 total.

items.title: LICENSED STORES
items.body: The licensed-store component completes the calculation.

slides.svgBlueprint: 540×800 viewBox. Center the full-width $222.4 hero at 84px, with 'million' on a separate 28px line. Place its body beneath in 22px Ink. Below a red calculation rule, position exactly two Surface footnote cards side by side; component numerals use 40px, never 84px. Connect the component cards to the hero with a restrained bracket indicating addition. Use the exact fiscal-end date as a shared caption. Avoid profit stamps or bank imagery.

slides.headline: Starbucks Gets Paid Before You Purchase
slides.subheadline: Interest-free prepayment benefits Starbucks; cash-outs and reload reversals face contractual restrictions.

telemetry.label: Cancellation notice before next scheduled reload

items.title: RESTRICTED EXIT
items.body: Cash redemption is generally unavailable unless law or contractual exceptions permit it.

items.title: RELOAD FRICTION
items.body: Cancel at least twenty-four (24) hours before scheduled reload; loaded transactions cannot reverse under this provision.

items.title: SEPARATE REFUND EXCEPTION
items.body: Unused eGifts qualify for refunds with the original receipt.

slides.svgBlueprint: 540×800 viewBox. Position two 44px telemetry badges in a narrow strip under the subheadline; keep 'at least' outside the numerical span. Below, draw exactly three full-width ledger rows at 125px intervals. Use 18px uppercase row titles and 22px bodies. Give the reload row a red margin rule and the refund row an open-corner outline, signaling an exception rather than a universal lock. No extra callouts or padlock covering all cash exits.

slides.headline: No Expiry. Real Breakage. Limited Cash-Out.
slides.subheadline: The advantage: interest-free prepayment plus nonredemption revenue—not an insured deposit business.​

items.title: FEDERAL EXPIRATION FLOOR
items.body: Covered funds generally cannot expire before five years from issuance or last load.

items.title: FEDERAL INACTIVITY PROTECTION

metric.label: Without a transaction before qualifying inactivity fees

items.body: Inactivity fees generally require at least 12 transaction-free months; Starbucks charges none.​

items.title: CALIFORNIA CASH-OUT RIGHT
items.body: Qualifying balances below $15 must be redeemed for cash, effective April 1, 2026.
